name: blueprint/pre-commit-gate
description: Every change ships through the same gate (Hermes requesting-code-review, righthand-native): rh_run executes the check chain (lint, typecheck, tests, secret scan), the store keeps one receipt per run, the guard can deny the dangerous step, and ship-if-green is a rule, not a mood.
use_cases: run the full check chain before a commit
deny a release unless the gate passed
the diff between two gate runs is the review
ingredients: rh_run per check: pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, secret-scan pattern (exit codes are the verdicts)
rh_store gate:<changeId>:<check> receipts { exitCode, tail, at }
guard rules (deny the release prefix until the receipts are green)
guardFactsFor + a golden for agent-built guards
recipe: run the chain: rh_run each check with bounded collect -> receipt per check -> all green: the gate passes and the receipt set IS the review evidence -> any red: the change stops, the failing tail goes into the receipt, and the fix loop reruns only the failed checks -> ship step runs behind a guard rule (ask or deny) that the receipts feed
result_kind: one receipt per check per change, plus the guard verdict

invoke_contract.gate: { changeId } -> { checks: { lint, typecheck, test, scan }, green: boolean }

config_variants.chain: lint + typecheck + test + secret-scan (the plugin's own is this shape)
config_variants.enforce: receipts only | guard deny on red | guard ask with the receipts

pitfalls: exit code is the verdict - a check that prints warnings and exits 0 is green, whatever the words say
rh_run is collect mode and bounded - keep tails short (last lines, not full logs)
the secret scan belongs IN the chain, before anything leaves the machine
receipts make the gate auditable: a red receipt is why the release did not happen
TDD fits the same loop: run the failing test first (red receipt), then the fix (green receipt)
cloud_limits: the same chain runs in a Worker or CI on the user's own Cloudflare; the receipts move with it
